name: gymsync
description: GymSync - Full Stack Fitness & Gym Management Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && (cd backend && npm install) && (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd admin-frontend && npm install)
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:admin
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
